Heard Sri D.R. Chaudhary, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sarvesh Pandey, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Ishan Deo Giri, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Pankaj Srivastava,
learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P. and perused the record.

This Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been moved seeking Anticipatory Bail in Case Crime No. 157 of 2021, under Sections 406, 409, 419, 420 IPC,
Police Station Chunar, District Mirzapur.
On 03.12.2021, a coordinate Bench of this Court, while granting interim anticipatory bail to the applicant, has passed following order :-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ishant Dev Giri, learned counsel for the complainant and learned AGA for the State.

sentences.text:
The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant,
Alpana Chaurasia with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 157 of 2021,
under Sections 406, 409, 419 and 420 I.P.C., P.S. Chunar, district-Mirzapur.

Prior notice of this bail application was served in the office of Government Advocate and as per Chapter XVIII, Rule 18 of the Allahabad High Court Rules and as per direction dated 20.11.2020 of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. 8072 of 2020, Govind Mishra @ Chhotu Versus State of U.P., hence, this anticipatory bail application is being heard.

sentences.text: Grant of further time to the learned A.G.A. as per Section 438 (3) Cr.P.C. (U.P. Amendment) is not required.

The first information report was lodged against the present accused, who was Marketing Inspector posted at Chunar and when she was transferred to Block Sikhad and tried to handover the charge, then the complainant who was posted in place of present accused at Chunar had lodged the first information report as complainant and alleging that he was not given the charge of about 1047 sacks of rice by the present accused.

Learned counsel for the applicant has contended that when the complainant had not taken the charge of 1047 sacks of rice, then the present accused requested to higher authorities that there was no place left in the godown where the food grains were kept, then she kept the food grains to another godown and that should be verified there and food grians should be taken into charge but the charge was not taken from her.
He further submits that there was no embezzlement in the stock of rice, which is still lying there in same quantity, hence no offence under Section 409 I.P.C. is made out against the applicant.
The applicant is having definite apprehension that she may be arrested by the police any time.

Sri Ishant Dev Giri, learned counsel for the complainant submits that firstly rice was embezzled by the applicant and when the matter was raised before higher forum,
then the present accused arranged another rice in place of previous one.
The submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, prima facie, appear to have some substance.
The matter requires consideration.
Both the counsels have submitted that they have to verify the papers of each other and seek two weeks' time.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, considering the nature of accusation and considering that the applicant is a lady government official, this Court as interim measure grants interim bail to the applicant and fixed the matter for disposal on 12.1.2022.

sentences.text: In the meantime, learned counsel for the parties may exchange their papers.
Learned A.G.A. may also file counter affidavit, if he so desires and seek instructions in the matter.
Let a copy of this order be given to learned A.G.A."
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that till date, no charge-sheet has been submitted in this case.
The applicant is cooperating with the investigation and did not misuse the liberty of aforesaid interim anticipatory bail which was granted on 03.12.2021 by the coordinate Bench of this Court.
Learned AGA for the State does not dispute the aforesaid factual aspect of the matter as argued on behalf of the applicant.
With the aforesaid observations and directions, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.
